2608.23214.title: Aligning Biomedical Texts and Knowledge Graphs: A Systematic Comparison of Lightweight Alignment Strategies
2608.23214.paper_summary: Biomedical knowledge exists in two complementary but distinct forms: unstructured scientific literature and structured knowledge graphs (KGs). Aligning them is essential for knowledge grounding, evidence retrieval, and KG completion, yet existing methods do not explicitly align free-text evidence with KG triples. We present a unified framework for systematically studying design choices for aligning biomedical text and KGs. With a text encoder and a KG embedding model both frozen, we learn only a lightweight projection between their spaces via a contrastive objective. This enables a fair comparison across six design dimensions: text encoder, KG embedding model, projection head, triple composition, training direction, and hard-negatives sampling. We construct CTD-Align, a corpus of over 22K one-to-one tripledocument pairs linking chemical-gene interactions from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database to supporting PubMed passages. We evaluate alignment on it in two retrieval settings: document-to-triple and triple-to-document. We find that the triple composition and the training direction (i.e., shared retrieval space) have the greatest impact, whereas the text encoder and hard-negatives sampling matter little. Overall, simple choices win: projecting text into the KG space with a linear head over concatenated subject, predicate, and object embeddings performs best. These findings establish lightweight contrastive alignment as an effective, practical foundation for bridging biomedical text and KGs.
2608.23214.paper_summary_zh: 生物醫學知識存在兩種互補但不同的形式：非結構化的科學文獻和結構化的知識圖譜（KGs）。將它們對齊對於知識基礎、證據檢索和KG的補全至關重要，但現有的方法並未明確將自由文本證據與KG三元組對齊。我們提出了一個統一框架，系統性地研究對齊生物醫學文本和KG的設計選擇。在文本編碼器和KG嵌入模型均保持不變的情況下，我們僅通過對比目標學習它們空間之間的輕量級投影。這使得我們能夠在六個設計維度上進行公平比較：文本編碼器、KG嵌入模型、投影頭、三元組組合、訓練方向和硬負樣本抽樣。我們構建了CTD-Align，一個包含超過22K一對一三元文件對的語料庫，將比較毒理基因組數據庫中的化學-基因相互作用鏈接到支持的PubMed段落。我們在兩個檢索設置上評估對齊：文檔到三元組和三元組到文檔。我們發現三元組組合和訓練方向（即共享檢索空間）對結果影響最大，而文本編碼器和硬負樣本抽樣影響較小。總體而言，簡單的選擇勝出：將文本通過線性頭投影到KG空間，並對連接的主題、謂詞和對象嵌入進行最佳表現。這些發現確立了輕量級對比對齊作為連接生物醫學文本和KG的有效、實用基礎。
